firstTimeGuide.paragraphOpener: If this is your first time adding a page in the VOCALOID Lyrics Wiki, you should note the following:
firstTimeGuide.tip1: The wikitext code should be added on Source Editor (also known as Wiki Editor), not Visual Editor. Click this link for a more detailed guide on editing.
firstTimeGuide.tip2: Remember to add redirects to pages to make them more easily searchable on the wiki. For example, when adding a page titled "ハロー・ワールド (Hello World)", you should add a redirect titled "Hello World" to make the song page searchable. Refer to this guideline on VOCALOID Lyrics Wiki for more information.
